title: Bee Flow module manifest
description: Descriptor for a downloadable Bee Flow Hub module (.bfmod). The product verifier (server/modules/packageVerify.js) enforces the load-bearing subset of this schema at install/boot; the full schema is enforced here at authoring/pack time.

manifestVersion.description: Manifest envelope version. 2 adds the permission manifest (permissions[]) and server.native/restart/schemaVersion/streamingRoutes. mv2 with a non-empty permissions list MUST declare hostApiVersion >= 3; mv2 capability ids must be '<id>' or '<id>_'-prefixed and kind 'core' is forbidden.

permissions.description: mv2 only. Host-API permission grants this module needs; empty/absent = core-only surface. Fixed taxonomy ids plus 'http:<host>', 'http:*.domain' or 'http:*'. Shown verbatim in the operator consent dialog.

id.description: Stable module slug. Must not collide with a built-in module id.

icon.description: lucide-react icon name (mapped on the client; falls back to Puzzle).

version.description: Semantic version of this module release.

hostApiVersion.description: Hard compatibility gate — the host-context surface the module was built against. The loader refuses a mismatch.

capabilities.description: Capability descriptors this module contributes to the registry.

entry.description: Path to the built CommonJS server entry (e.g. server/entry.cjs) exporting createModule(host).

routes.description: Advisory list of route prefixes the module mounts under the dispatcher.

stores.description: Advisory list of store names the module initialises.

native.description: mv2. True when the package contains native addons (*.node) — updates STAGE and require a restart.

restart.description: mv2. Restart policy for updates: 'auto' (host decides from package contents), 'never' (hot-swap always safe), 'always' (stage every update for the next restart).

schemaVersion.description: mv2. Monotonic version of the module's OWN database schema; rollback to a lower schemaVersion is guarded (409 schema_downgrade unless forced).

streamingRoutes.description: mv2. Route prefixes exempt from the host's per-request deadline (SSE / long-poll endpoints).

entry.description: Path to the built ESM frontend entry (e.g. frontend/index.js), react family externalised.

css.description: CSS files injected as <link> when the module UI mounts.

gateCapability.description: Capability id that must be entitled for the Studio tab to render.

sharedDependencies.description: Bare specifiers the module expects the host to provide via import map (react family is always shared).

requirements.description: Runtime prerequisites surfaced to the operator (docker socket, images, env patterns).
